proof: Zero-based grey cells: (1,3),(2,3),(2,2),(0,1),(1,1),(0,0). True reflection x=3 gives (4,3),(3,3),(3,2),(5,1),(4,1),(5,0). Letters A=(3,3),B=(4,3),C=(5,0),D=(4,1),E=(4,0); E alone uncovered. False lower-L halfturn gives(5,1),(5,0),(4,0), with upper L correctly reflected, so A/B/C/E covered and D omitted. Six existing edge intervals change no grey fill, grid, crease or letter.
